patch.value: Fix the output_format service override so it declines unclaimed payloads instead of echoing the command context

Under pm-cli 2026.7.27 an output_format service override's bare return value IS what the host renders. This extension declined by returning the inbound sctx.payload at index.ts line 1979, which 2026.7.27 no longer reads as not-handled, so every command in any workspace with pm-slack-standup installed printed the whole command context with global, format and options keys instead of its own result. The decline path now returns the ServiceOverrideDecision object handled false, which pm's isServiceOverrideDecision predicate accepts only when handled is false and the object has exactly that one key. The claim path is unchanged and still hands the standup export string to the host verbatim so the documented compare round-trip keeps producing valid JSON. Filed upstream as unbraind/pm-cli#776. Paired with the 2026.7.27 dependency adoption because 2026.7.26 has no isServiceOverrideDecision at all, so the regression tests can only exercise the real contract once the dependency is bumped.

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Three regression tests added to test/smoke.test.ts through the REAL SDK harness createExtensionTestHarness plus runRegisteredServiceOverrideForTest: an unrelated command payload must be declined, standup export raw stdout must still be claimed verbatim, and a standup export without the raw_stdout marker must be declined. The suite previously used no harness at all so the override's return value was never evaluated.

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Falsification verified: reverting the decline path to sctx?.payload fails 2 of the 3 new tests (92 pass 2 fail) while the claim-path test correctly still passes because claiming was never affected. Restoring the fix gives 94 pass 0 fail.

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Production proof in a throwaway workspace with two seeded items: install ok with no warnings, pm list renders items, pm list --json is valid JSON, standup export --format json emits raw verbatim JSON with keys date groupBy sections counts sections_data slack, and pm standup --help registers.

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Gates: build, typecheck, check, 94/94 tests, changelog:full and changelog:check after git fetch --tags --force.

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Greptile review on the sibling pm-starter PR caught that package.json said 2026.7.27 while manifest.json and the index.ts self-reported version constant still said 2026.7.26. The same gap existed here and was fixed proactively by aligning manifest.json and the version constant and rebuilding, before a reviewer had to raise it a second time.

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Disclosure from bot review: Greptile noticed the PR also raises the pm-changelog devDependency from caret 2026.7.26 to caret 2026.7.27. That was incidental scope from a blanket version string replacement rather than a deliberate change. Verified valid and kept: pm-changelog 2026.7.27 is the published latest, npm install reported 0 vulnerabilities, and the full 94-test suite plus changelog:full and changelog:check are green on it. Disclosed explicitly in the PR body rather than silently reverted, since pm-changelog is the very tool that regenerates the CHANGELOG in this PR. pm-starter had no incidental dependency change.
